prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Video 1 shows only the movement: she moves like the dealer in video 1, with the same timing. Both her hands rise calmly and go to the shoe: her hand nearest the shoe lays its fingertips on the yellow card in the window, ready to stroke it out, and her other hand comes to wait close beside the shoe, as in the last frame. Her eyes go down to her hand at the card and stay there, as in the last frame. One soft, unbroken movement from the first frame to the last, with no pause and no jerk, and she leans no further forward than in the last frame.
